findings.evidence: Filtration.lean:561-563 now needs `change (wordFiltration (ι Q) 0).FG` before `rw [wordFiltration_zero, ...]`, while `rw [filtration_succ_eq_sup]` still works at line 566; Vectors.lean:221-222 replaces `← filtration_one` with `exact (TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration_one (ι Q)).symm` under the comment "The Clifford filtration is the reducible alias of the generic word filtration". Grep confirms no `filtration_zero`/`filtration_one`/`one_mem_filtration` declarations remain in TauCeti/.
findings.fix: Restore `filtration_zero : filtration Q 0 = 1`, `filtration_one : filtration Q 1 = 1 ⊔ LinearMap.range (ι Q)` and `one_mem_filtration` as plain (non-`@[simp]`, since `wordFiltration_zero`/`wordFiltration_one` already carry `@[simp]` and reach these goals through the reducible alias) restatements delegating to the generic lemmas; or, if the specialized layer is meant to go, delete the remaining `filtration_*` wrappers too and phrase everything generically, rather than keeping an arbitrary half.
findings.issue: `filtration` stays a public definition with a wrapper layer (`filtration_eq_pow`, `filtration_le_iff`, `filtration_mono`, `filtration_mul`, `mul_mem_filtration`, `filtration_pow`, `filtration_eq_iSup_pow`, `filtration_succ_eq_sup`, `ι_mem_filtration_one`, ...), but its two value-computing characteristic lemmas `filtration_zero` and `filtration_one`, plus `one_mem_filtration`, were deleted. Since `rw`/`kabstract` keys on the head constant and does not unfold the `abbrev`, consumers holding `filtration Q 0` or `filtration Q 1` can no longer rewrite by name and must hand-unfold to `wordFiltration (ι Q) _` first.

summary: The new generic associated-graded surface is minimal, private-where-appropriate and fully characterized with correct annotations. But turning `CliffordAlgebra.filtration` into an `abbrev` came with the deletion of `filtration_zero`, `filtration_one` and `one_mem_filtration` while the rest of the `filtration_*` wrapper layer was kept, leaving the public definition without its degree-0/1 restatements under its own name.
